tasks.summary_pl: Masa $4$g maleje o $19\%$/dobę. Po ilu dobach $<1,5$g?
tasks.summary_en: Mass $4$g decays $19\%$/day. After how many days $<1.5$g?
tasks.statement_en: At the initial moment ($t=0$) the mass of a substance equals $4$ grams. Due to decay of its particles, the mass decreases: after each successive day, $19\%$ of the mass present at the end of the previous day is lost. For every non-negative integer $t$, the function $m(t)$ gives the mass of the substance, in grams, after $t$ full days (time counted from the initial moment). Find the formula for the function $m(t)$. Compute after how many full days the mass of the substance will, for the first time, be less than $1.5$ grams. Show your working.
tasks.notes: only the numeric part (number of days = 5) is counted; the formula m(t)=4*0.81^t is symbolic

tasks.statement_en: Tomek and Romek decided to play five games of chess against each other. The probability that Tomek wins a single game equals $\dfrac14$. Compute the probability that Tomek wins at least four of the five games. Give the result as an irreducible common fraction. Show your working.

The function $f$ is defined by $f(x)=\dfrac{3x^2-2x}{x^2+2x+8}$ for every real number $x$. The point $P=(x_0,3)$ belongs to the graph of $f$. Compute $x_0$ and find the equation of the tangent line to the graph of $f$ at point $P$. Show your working.
tasks.notes: only x_0 is numeric; the tangent-line equation is symbolic and not counted in value
general solution x=7pi/12+k*pi or 11pi/12+k*pi, k in Z (no bounded domain given) - infinite set

tasks.summary_pl: Sześcian $a=6$, $S$ - przecięcie przekątnych ściany $ADHE$. Wys. $\triangle SBH$?
tasks.summary_en: Cube $a=6$, $S$ = diagonals of face $ADHE$ meet. Altitude of $\triangle SBH$?
tasks.statement_en: Given is a cube $ABCDEFGH$ with edge length $6$. Point $S$ is the intersection point of diagonals $AH$ and $DE$ of the lateral face $ADHE$ (see figure). Compute the altitude of triangle $SBH$ drawn from point $S$ to side $BH$ of this triangle. Show your working. [Figure: cube ABCDEFGH, with S at the intersection of diagonals AH and DE on face ADHE]

tasks.summary_pl: Czworokąt opisany na okręgu, $BC=4$, $CD=5$, kąt $60°$. Oblicz obwód
tasks.summary_en: Tangential quadrilateral, $BC=4$, $CD=5$, angle $60°$. Find the perimeter
tasks.statement_en: Quadrilateral $ABCD$, in which $|BC|=4$ and $|CD|=5$, is circumscribed about a circle. The diagonal $AC$ of this quadrilateral makes a $60°$ angle with side $BC$, and makes an acute angle with side $AB$ whose sine equals $\dfrac14$. Compute the perimeter of quadrilateral $ABCD$. Show your working.
tasks.notes: [verified: ok: Sine law: AB=4*sin60/(1/4)=8sqrt3; tangential quad: Ob=2(AB+CD)=16sqrt3+10, matches key. Unique.]
sum L=8(4+sqrt10)a/3 is expressed in terms of the given side length a, not a specific number

tasks.statement_en: The function $f$ is defined by $f(x)=81^{\log_3 x}+\dfrac{2\cdot\log_2\sqrt{27}\cdot\log_3 2}{3}\cdot x^2-6x$ for every positive number $x$ (this expression can be shown to equal $x^4+x^2-6x$). Compute the smallest value of the function $f$. Show your working.

tasks.summary_pl: Prosta $x-y-2=0$ i parabola $y=4x^2-7x+1$ w $A,B$. Oblicz $C$ (suma wsp.)
tasks.summary_en: Line $x-y-2=0$ meets parabola $y=4x^2-7x+1$ at $A,B$. Find $C$ (sum of coords)
tasks.statement_en: In the Cartesian coordinate system $(x,y)$, the line $l$ with equation $x-y-2=0$ intersects the parabola with equation $y=4x^2-7x+1$ at points $A$ and $B$. Segment $AB$ is a diameter of circle $\mathcal{O}$. Point $C$ lies on circle $\mathcal{O}$ above line $l$, and angle $BAC$ is acute with measure $\alpha$ such that $\tan\alpha=\dfrac13$ (see figure). Compute the coordinates of point $C$. Show your working. [Figure: parabola y=4x^2-7x+1, line l, circle O with diameter AB, point C above l with angle BAC=alpha]
tasks.notes: sum of the coordinates of C: 11/10 + (-3/10) = 4/5
